newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's KEL to offer 100 mln new shrs at HK$1.00/shr.
newsitem.headline: HK's KEL to offer 100 mln new shrs at HK$1.00/shr.

text.p: Electrical and mechanical engineering services concern KEL Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it is issuing 100 million new shares at HK$1.00 each in its initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong.

The issue price represents a price/earnings multiple of 7.19 times on a pro-forma fully-diluted basis and 5.78 times on a weighted average basis. The prospective annual dividend yield is 5.2 percent and the adjusted net tangible asset value amounts to HK$0.452 per share, the company said in a statement.
KEL, a spinoff of marine engineering group UDL Holdings Ltd, will have a market capitalisation of HK$400 million.
The IPO will run from April 10 to 15 and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on April 24.
Amsteel Corporate Finance (H.K.) Ltd is the sponsor and manager of the issue, and UOB Asia Ltd is the co-sponsor.
KEL is engaged in the design, supply, installation and maintenance of electrical and mechanical engineering services in the building and construction industry in Hong Kong and China.
The company said net proceeds would be about HK$90 million, of which HK$40 million would be used for business expansion while the balance would be used as additional working capital.

"Recently, we have been involved in some major projects such as the Ground Transportation Centre and the new Lufthansa Catering Facilties at Chek Lap Kok Airport," chairman Y.T. Leung said in the statement.

KEL forecasts combined profit after tax but before extraordinary items of not less than HK$52 million for the year ended March 1997, up from HK$40.52 million in 1995/96 and HK$35.06 million in 1994/95.
